scripts.start: concurrently "npm run start:backend" "npm run start:web" "npm run start:admin" "npm run start:landing"
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --prefix="[{name}]" --names="backend,web,admin,landing" "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:admin" "npm run dev:landing"
scripts.test:dev: concurrently --success first --kill-others "echo 'Backend would start'" "echo 'Web would start'" "echo 'Admin would start'" "echo 'Landing would start'"
scripts.reset: npm run clean && npm run install:all
